narr: Thunderstorms occurred over the metro area of Corpus Christi during the late evening of the 30th. The storms produced very heavy rainfall that lead to flash flooding over portions of the city.
ev: Streets near HEB in Flour Bluff along with nearby streets were flooded with several cars stranded.
Streets were flooded near the intersection of Saratoga Boulevard and Everheart Road in Corpus Christi.
Streets were flooded around downtown Corpus Christi.
